description: 국토교통부_국토교통부_도로중심선(WMS/WFS) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 국토지리정보원 연속수치지형도 도로중심선 데이터 RestAPI로 호출하면 json/xml로 데이터를 반환합니다 OGC 국제표준으로 API를 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 연속수치지형도, 도로중심, 도로, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-07-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
